summary: Layer31 capacity recovery with scratch-empty/buffer-2.75 did not produce a retained candidate. The best confirmed candidate (0.8125) saved block cache (5638.0 vs 5673.0 MiB) and peak GPU memory (29832.0 vs 29884.0 MiB), but confirmed decode/e2e regressed (189.169124/3.257162 vs opt013 198.036572/3.268888); fallback 0.875 failed one-round e2e.
